dict.string: Your daily routine (medicines, exercise, meals) is mirrored to the Calendar app so your family can see it too. The app works fully even if you say no.
Events you keep in the Calendar app (doctor visits, family plans) can be read so they appear here with a reminder. Nothing is ever written to your calendar. The app works fully even if you say no.
Reminders you keep in the Reminders app can be read so they appear here with a reminder. Nothing is ever written to them. The app works fully even if you say no.
Reminders you keep in the Reminders app can be read so they appear here with a reminder. Nothing is ever written to them. The app works fully even if you say no.

The camera is used to verify medication intake, and to photograph appliances, remotes, or screens when you ask for help using them. Appliance photos are sent to the assistant's cloud service so it can guide you.
Searching from the phone screen can call anyone in your phone book — including people added by WhatsApp, Messenger and other apps. The app works fully even if you say no.
The assistant needs microphone access to listen for your voice commands and wake word. Your voice data never leaves this device.
Speech recognition runs entirely on-device to understand your voice commands. No audio is sent to the cloud.
